family: Conditional precision in F: J_F+J_v/a(tau)^2, with both contributions nonnegative. Equivalently sd_F=s_ref/sqrt(1-lambda+lambda*(a_ref/a)^2), lambda in[0,1], a_ref=1-exp(-1). This is a normalized posterior family, not a second prior update.
ownership: Same construction/heldout split and fixed memberships; posterior owns prior and source interval once; no fresh inference or truth.

optimizer.method: Feasible BFGS with exact one-bound quadratic subproblem and constrained gradient residual

initialization: Exact saved baseline at lambda0, with QR whitening of original F features. All learned quantities use construction populations only.
seeds: Reuse saved natural-refit batch seeds for each arm; common seeds are not a guarantee of paired draws after rejection decisions differ.
checks: Every regression derivative including nonconstant intercept column
All13probes, source/construction disagreement, full covariance and mixed response moments
decision: Report all arms and failures; assess variance correction against construction and heldout, with all probe regressions and batch variability visible. No heldout optimization, no arbitrary scalar accuracy threshold.
adaptation_policy: One registered information-combination follow-up. Preserve endpoint failure. Do not tune the candidate to heldout. Report first-order local checks and all regressions.
limits: Finite population agreement is not coverage
No physical aging or causal update qualification
rationale: Full physical scaling improves prefix8 slow response but overcorrects prefix32. Construction-only precision-direction scores favor added physical precision for slow8, slow32 component0 and slightly fast32; others favor the baseline boundary.
